parsed.main_gap: Lemma 2, the central weight-descent step used to prove finiteness of all minimal supports, is asserted without proof.

errors.description: Lemma 2 is essential and omitted. One must iterate: if w(C\{p})≥a₁, that rejected integer has a smaller accepted coprime witness; a minimal support inside the witness still contains p and has strictly smaller weight outside p.
errors.quote: This follows by a descent on the weight $w$ (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: All other reductions, the sunflower argument, periodicity, and the final indexing are correct. The missing descent is localized and straightforward to supply, so the proof is essentially complete.
